{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/trial.csv')

# Deduplicate: keep highest sample_seq per patient_id
# Sort by sample_seq descending, then drop duplicates on patient_id
df_dedup = df.sort_values(by='sample_seq', ascending=False).drop_duplicates(subset=['patient_id'], keep='first')

# Verify deduplication worked
print(f"After deduplication: {len(df_dedup)} rows, {df_dedup['patient_id'].nunique()} unique patients")

# Check response rates by arm
response_by_arm = df_dedup.groupby('arm')['responded'].mean()
print(f"Response rates by arm:\n{response_by_arm}")

# Compute difference in proportions (treatment - control)
treatment_prop = response_by_arm['treatment']
control_prop = response_by_arm['control']
diff = treatment_prop - control_prop

print(f"Difference in proportions (treatment - control): {diff}")

# Check if arm and severity are confounded
print(f"Cross-tab: arm vs severity after deduplication\n{pd.crosstab(df_dedup['arm'], df_dedup['severity'])}")"}
